notes.title: Hopalong: The Badlands Post Release Update v1.02 - 03/14/18
notes.notes:
Have you been eye’n a new pair of boots? Maybe a fancy new thing of reigns, or a new ten-gallon hat? Well do we have news for you! 
Now you can afford all that, and a side of Boomity!  Hopalong: The Badlands is now available for $14.99 on Steam!  We have also fixed a multitude of issues and bugs throughout the Badlands, thanks in part to all of the amazing feedback we have gotten back from ya’ll folks! A full change log can be found below…

 Hopalong: The Badlands Post Release Update v1.02 

Acquiring the Pickaxe in the mines now plays the correct VO for Oculus players
Fixed an issue where players could pause the game while loading the next level, which would result in the player’s view not fading in
Fixed a major bug when attempting to record in Mixed Reality
Fixed a bug where Bandits would start a cult and attempt a seance
Removed tumbleweed sass VO


That’s all for now, but be on the lookout for a whole barrel’s worth of news in the near future... 
Be sure to follow us on  Twitter @fromfuturegames for all your VR, Badlands, and general tech news and Future updates! 

Stay tuned cowboys...

notes.title: Hopalong: The Badlands Post Release Update v1.01 - 1/29/18
notes.notes:
We’ve been diggin’ in our boot heels to bring you the next update to Hopalong: The Badlands! The Badlands now runs much smoother on lower end machines and a whole army of bugs have been hunted down and brought to justice. A full changelog can be found below. 

Hopalong: The Badlands Post Release Update v1.01 - 1/29/18
 - Optimization for lower end machines
 - Bug Fixes
 - Bug removal
 - Overall mass exodus of bugs
 - Reinstated bandit curfew. Obviously they were not ready for that responsibility

Lower End Machine Optimization
The darndest thing, we were enjoying a fine day out on the Badlands when we came across a hang up for low end CPUs and thought: “By George we could fix that there issue!” So we did. We have added stereo instancing to reduce draw calls and increase performance for lower end CPUs, so you can focus less on performance and more on slinging lead.

And that’s all for now Western fans! Be sure to follow us on Twitter @fromfuturegames for all your VR, Badlands, and general tech news and Future updates!

notes.title: Hopalong: The Badlands Release Update v1.0 - 11/21/2017
notes.notes:
More shiny than a sheriff’s spurs and twice as deadly, Hopalong: The Badlands is now fully released! We have been placing cacti, revving up tumbleweeds, and getting them Boomity boys in makeup as fast as we’ve been able to bring you the roughest, toughest, kookiest Western VR shooter this side of the Mississippi! And on the other side for that matter.
We cannot thank our community enough for your support throughout our development process. We have taken your feedback from the Early Access and have created a bigger, better Badlands. Be sure to keep up with us here on Steam and give more feedback in the weeks to come!

Hopalong: The Badlands v1.0 Update Notes
- All new VO and audio
- All new Canyon Chapter Expansion 
- New enemy types
- Updated original bandit models
- New weapons and mounts to unlock
- All new Sheriff Quickdraw ability and mechanic 
- Over 25 unique steam achievements 
- Added chapter continue functionality 
- New PFX and environmental effects
- A literal metric ton of polish 
- Major performance improvements in all levels
- Removed bug where Dynamite Gang acted as an accapella group 
- Addressed Boss Boomity’s God Complex attitude bug
- Removed bandit curfew. They’ve been good. 

New Weapons
Bring a whole new definition to lead slinging with the Iron Falcon. All the power of a cannon in the hand of a lawman that knows how to put a bandit in the dirt! Whether your target is scrawny or brawny, this hand cannon knows just the right sized hole for his dirt nap.
The caves in the Badlands can get a tad dark at times, but a Sheriff has nothing to fear with The Brimstone Gun on his back. Shed a little light on even the darkest depths and maybe even a Bandit or two along the way.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/5e0a07b45a0cd0e42cfae1a5b058595ed6812520.png

New Enemy: The Heavy
Twice as mean as a normal Boomity boy and four times the size, The Heavy is sure to give a challenge to even the most veteran arm of the law. Be sure to keep your peepers peeled for this hefty fella out in those cliffs, Sheriff. Oh and, duck if you get the chance.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/abf2c527d481d37a8ae1f1924e4abe5b7e88f4d8.png

New Canyon Chapter
There’ve been rumors about just how deep the cliffs of the Badlands go, and now we know for sure. Complete with perilous heights, dangerous caverns, and sprawling wooded landscapes, The Canyon Chapter expansion is sure to test just how far you can dish out justice. Watch yer’ step!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/2f8c8c7445ff0600b7683e0c458b41c07bb435f7.png

Happy Hoppin’!

notes.title: Hopalong: The Badlands Heads for Release!
notes.notes:
Howdy Cowpokes!

Hop in those boots and polish off your badges because Hopalong: The Badlands is headed for full release! We have been working hard to bring you our next update which will also signify Hopalong’s full release, jam packed with all new levels, weapons, and mounts for you to discover and unlock. But don’t get too big for your britches just yet, because the Boomity Clan has a few new tricks of their own. Some new features include, but aren’t limited to…


    An all new expansion of levels to explore
    Revamped VO and audio
    Explosion and environment polish
    Brand new enemies, weapons, mounts and abilities


Our release will be here very soon, so make sure you’ve got your eight shooter and your trusty stick steed ready to ventilate the countryside!

Stay tuned Cowboys...

notes.title: Hopalong: The Badlands Minor Miner Update - 6/28/2017
notes.notes:
Following the Major Miner Update, its the Minor Miner update! We’ve been hard at work down in the dev mines working on even more content. In the meantime, we’ve busted out the heavy duty polish and have given the latest build of Hopalong: The Badlands a nice new sheen.

Hopalong: The Badlands v0.8.5 Update Notes
- Added Bullet Time Effect
- Major Bug Fixes in Canyon Levels
- Added Stats to Horses
- Major Bug Fixes in the Town Level
- Major Performance Improvements
- General Bug Fixes
- Removed Gang of Scorpions Loitering by Canyon Exit 
- Instilled Strict 9:00 Curfew for all Dynamite Gang Members 

Bullet Time Weapon Switch
Honing in on their inner Lawkeeper, the Sheriff has developed a new technique to help thwart those Boomity boys and their nefarious plans. Now when switching weapons, a slow time effect activates allowing the player to pull off some crazy shots!

http://i.imgur.com/TGaxwoD.gif

Horse Stats
Now when mounting up, there won’t be any confusion as to what kind of steed you’ll be riding! Above each horse you can now find stats describing what each ride does for you. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/e25fad415c4d29cf9776eae2f6c04efda41cc48a.jpg

Coming Soon
The wind is heating up from deep within the Canyon. The sun is setting and the rocks are shifting. Something is coming Sheriff, better stay alert…

Join us on twitter  for more information and to follow the adventures of Ol' Mad Mike as he uncovers clues about updates to come.
 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/a1866a150fbbf286d1917d54be3402e9a9faa94d.png

notes.title: Hopalong: The Badlands Major Miner Update - 5/25/2017
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/73b6c95f84984fd8a9fe619bd84998e32ab9ba8a.png

You wanted it, and we answered! The Major Miner Update for Hopalong: The Badlands is now live! Jam packed full of twists, turns, explosions, and sarcasm, this update is sure to meet all your wild west dreams…

Hopalong: The Badlands v0.8 Update Notes
- Outskirts has been expanded into an entire chapter with 4 new areas to explore
- 2 all new Outskirts areas
- 2 brand new Mine areas within the Outskirts chapter
- Added hidden collectibles for players to find
- Performance improvements for bandit AI
- Removed sad tumbleweed from Canyon level, increased mood by 30%
- Added new VO work
- Fixed bug where stick horses became sentient and attempted a revolution
- More bug fixes


Expanded Outskirts Chapter
We’ve added two brand new explorable outdoor areas to the Outskirts level already in game. Speed through cliff passes, find hidden paths, and breathe in the wide new vistas!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/9d7d4a22b177a7b2e6c76de8385ea4ec59172bec.png

New Mines Areas
Deep in the hills and cliffs, the Boomity Boys have taken over the minecart system and set up shop! In addition to the Outskirts areas, there are two all new Mines for players to explore. Packed full of dark corners, hidden passages, and xplosive puzzles, there’s no telling what the Sheriff will face in those dark caves…

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/721c2c027c7b8ea1bfe1a8d43c705350739e0cfa.png

Collectibles
Players can now find Sheriff Stars hidden throughout each of the levels. The amount collected thus far is displayed outside of each tunnel in the main menu of the game. Think you can dodge, duck, and dig your way to each stars hiding spot?

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/23fd0d960ddd8ba7d23c7aa99c59465b77f6dab6.png

Coming Soon
Careful Sheriff, them Boomity boys in the canyons have been talking amongst themselves since you got here… Something about changing up their tactics.

Join us on twitter for more information and to follow the adventures of Ol' Mad Mike as he uncovers clues about updates to come.

notes.title: Hopalong: The Badlands Update v0.7 - 5/3/2017
notes.notes:
Wooah girl. Tighten up that saddle strap because we’ve got a new build of Hopalong: The Badlands out now, and it’s filled with extra bad baddies and plenty of horse play…

Hopalong: The Badlands v0.7 Update Notes
- Added new horse abilities
- Added difficulty settings
- Player's dynamite weapon fuse now visually burns down.
- Improved bandit AI
- Made bandits more resilient to pick
- Switched stick horse feed from hay to magic alfalfa
- Held violence seminar for dynamite gang

Horse Abilities
Faster, stronger, more deadly. Your favorite trusty steed now has it’s own ability to keep you safe and help thwart those nasty dynamite boys. Need more health? Want to ride as fast as a rattlesnake’s bite? Swing by the corral and check em out!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/6a49b87bb8e07b50769a57ebb7bc6782d923a796.png

Difficulty Settings
Ever thought to yourself “these dynamite boys aren’t so tough. I could do this with my eyes closed”? Well then do we have a solution for you! You can now change the difficulty of the game before entering a level with our new difficulty settings. Be wary, only the boldest riders should try the higher settings…

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/21ea7a5732aa9ee8b33db16faf0cf6b835dd9c2e.png

Coming Soon
Our team is hard at work creating new and explosive areas to explore. Here's just a hint of new levels to come. Check us out on twitter for more information and future updates!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28293254/fed6f533e1b7ef001e319f2bd2fe1c5e31ac0eac.jpg

notes.title: Hopalong: The Badlands Update v0.6 - 4/11/2017
notes.notes:
Howdy cowpokes! We've just uploaded a new build of Hopalong: The Badlands that includes the following changes:

        - Fixed some body collision issues
	- Fixed a visual bug with gun unlocks
	- Fixed some collision issues with player horses and weapons
	- Fixed an issue with weapon swapping sometimes resulting in holding an invisible weapon.
	- Fixed an issue where AI would not always pursue player
	- That darn hat in the main menu is movable now

Our plan for the weeks ahead will focus on expanding the first level, Outskirts, into an entire chapter containing multiple areas, new visuals, and new secrets to uncover.

We'll also be adding some new horsey-related features, as well as a new difficulty system for all you rough riding tough desperados out there.

Let us know if you have any other ideas or feedback, we'd love to hear it!
